title: Jev turn guard in keryx shell: after the agent's reply, check whether the user's request was actually done

AC1.note: src/review/turn-guard.ts extractTurnGuardFacts (L206-278): pure, synchronous, no model call. Builds TurnGuardFacts from TurnGuardTranscript{userRequest, finalMessage, toolCalls}: toolCallCount/toolsCalled/failedTools/anyToolFailed, filesWritten (apply_patch-shaped calls), commandsRun+testsRun (shell_exec-shaped calls, exit codes via exitCodeOf, pass/fail via parseTestCounts), lastTestRunFailed, markers (INCOMPLETE_MARKERS: I could not/unable to/TODO/not done/etc), asksQuestion. buildTurnGuardState (L369-382) renders the bounded, redacted state text passed to Jev. Covered by src/review/turn-guard.test.ts 'AC1: extractTurnGuardFacts' describe block (38 tests total in file, all passing).

AC2.note: src/review/turn-guard.ts buildTurnGuardQuestions() (L342-361): the two noul questions (done, contradiction). Redaction via redactSensitiveText from src/security/service.ts (buildTurnGuardState L369-382, security-facade import per file header). TURN_GUARD_TOKEN_BUDGET=64_000 preflighted via preflightBudget in src/tui/turn-guard-source.ts runTurnGuard (L167-168) before the Jev call. TURN_GUARD_JEV_TIMEOUT_MS=8_000 (turn-guard.ts L40), enforced via callJevSystemOne's timeoutMs; pinned by turn-guard-source.test.ts 'AC2: bounded by a short timeout, never hangs' using a hangingFetch() that never resolves - asserts <2s wall time. Non-blocking: tui-shell.ts fires the guard with bare 'void (async () => {...})()' inside the turn's .finally() callback, never awaited (turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts 'AC2: the guard run is fired with void'). PR #720 review item 2 fix (this session): the guard's deferred continuation now checks turnSignal.aborted||foregroundOperation.isDisposed before touching history/sidebar/onSystem, since the up-to-8s await can outlive the turn/renderer (tui-shell.ts ~L7907-7940, source-text audited by turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts new tests).

AC3.note: src/review/turn-guard.ts detectTurnGuardContradiction (L312-337): decides false-test-pass-claim and unmentioned-failure WITHOUT Jev; turn-guard-source.ts runTurnGuard checks this before any Jev call (holds with zero credential - turn-guard-source.test.ts 'holds even with NO credential at all'). PR #720 review item 1 fix (this session, the actual work of this pass): shell_exec marks ANY nonzero exit isError:true, so grep-no-match/test -f false/diff/git diff --exit-code previously false-flagged as unmentioned-failure with no real failure. Narrowed via new TurnGuardFacts.deterministicFailedTools (turn-guard.ts L91-102): a shell_exec failure only counts deterministically when SHELL_TOOL_INFRA_FAILURE_RE matches (tool itself timed out/aborted/denied/failed to start, L132-144) OR the command tokenises (commandSegments/commandTokens, L146-197) to a build/test/install/typecheck runner (isBuildTestInstallTypecheckCommand). Non-shell tool failures unaffected. false-test-pass-claim narrowed by TEST_FAILURE_ACKNOWLEDGED_RE (L178-184): a message acknowledging the failure (N failed, pre-existing, flaky, except) is not flagged. New tests: src/review/turn-guard.test.ts 'Item 1 (PR #720 review)' describe block (9 tests: grep-no-match/test -f/diff/git diff --exit-code NOT flagged, flaky-acknowledged NOT flagged, real bun-test-failure/timeout/denial STILL flagged). Revert-checked this session: reverting turn-guard.ts's fix via git apply -R makes exactly the 8 new negative-case tests fail (deterministicFailedTools mismatches), confirming they test the fix and not something vacuous; re-applied and re-verified green.

AC4.note: src/tui/turn-guard-inspector.ts: /guard modal (openTurnGuard) with History/Detail tabs; formatTurnGuardListLines/formatTurnGuardDetailLines render facts, Jev probabilities and the reason via renderTurnGuardAdvisory (turn-guard.ts L449-478). renderTurnGuardNoticeLine (turn-guard.ts L444-446) prints one compact English line ('Guard: request may be incomplete - <reason> /guard for details'), wired in tui-shell.ts only inside 'if (guardResult.verdict.flagged)' (turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts asserts this). Nothing shown when not flagged: recordGuardResult still records every turn (flagged or not) for the modal, but the inline notice line only prints on flagged. Notice never auto-continues the agent - the guard's async IIFE only calls recordGuardResult/refreshGuardSidebar/io.onSystem, never re-dispatches a turn.

AC5.note: src/lib/shell-config.ts ShellConfig.turnGuard?.enabled (L116-124), default off/absent. tui-shell.ts: guardEnabled = opts.initialGuardEnabled ?? loadShellConfig().turnGuard?.enabled===true (falls back to persisted setting, turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts 'AC5: --guard falls back'); --guard CLI flag documented in docs/docs/cli-reference.md L146/162; /guard on|off via setGuardEnabled persists through saveShellConfig({turnGuard:{enabled:next}}) and refreshes the sidebar (turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts 'AC5: /guard on/off toggle persists'). Sidebar state shown via refreshGuardSidebar ('on * N checked[, M flagged]'). PR #720 review item 5 fix (this session): added a comment at the saveShellConfig({turnGuard:...}) call site (tui-shell.ts, setGuardEnabled) documenting that saveShellConfig only shallow-merges at the top level, so a future second field on turnGuard must be read-and-spread first (mirroring saveProviderBaseUrl/saveProviderModelParams in src/lib/shell-config.ts) or it would be silently dropped on toggle.

AC6.note: src/tui/turn-guard-source.ts TurnGuardResult.usage: JevUsage (input/output tokens, cost) recorded from callJevSystemOne's own response, same as other Jev-backed review commands (ci-triage/conform); shown in the /guard modal detail via renderTurnGuardAdvisory's usageLine (turn-guard.ts L460-463) and in turn-guard-inspector's statusSummary/formatTurnGuardDetailLines. Skip rule: shouldSkipTurnGuard (turn-guard.ts L281-287) - no tool calls AND userRequest<=TURN_GUARD_TRIVIAL_REQUEST_CHARS(80) AND finalMessage<=TURN_GUARD_TRIVIAL_REPLY_CHARS(200); documented at both consts (L45-47) and the function's own doc comment; tested in turn-guard.test.ts 'AC6: shouldSkipTurnGuard' (4 tests: trivial skipped; any tool call never skipped; long request/reply never skipped) and turn-guard-source.test.ts 'AC6: a trivial turn is skipped without asking Jev' (asserts no fetch call at all).

AC7.note: Pure-function tests: src/review/turn-guard.test.ts (38 tests - fact extraction, contradiction detection, skip rule, question/state building, verdict computation, notice/advisory rendering; PR #720 item 1 adds 9 tests for the narrowed deterministic rule). Shell render tests: src/tui/turn-guard-inspector.test.ts (modal list/detail formatting). Non-blocking pinned with a hanging fake Jev: src/tui/turn-guard-source.test.ts 'AC2: bounded by a short timeout, never hangs' (hangingFetch() that only resolves on abort; asserts <2s and skipped:true). Wiring source-text audit: src/tui/turn-guard-shell-wiring.test.ts (10 tests, extended this session for PR #720 item 2's turnSignal/isDisposed guard) and src/tui/tui-shell.test.ts 'flow 219 - foreground operation lifecycle wiring' (updated this session for the turnSignal capture). Hermetic: every test above drives an injected fake fetch or pure functions, no real network (the live-check script is the one deliberate real-network exception, run separately for AC8). macOS-safe: no OS-specific APIs (fs/path/Date only). Revert-checked this session for all three PR #720 fixes: item 1 (src/review/turn-guard.ts) - reverting makes exactly the 8 new item-1 tests fail; item 2/3/5 (src/tui/tui-shell.ts) - reverting makes both new turn-guard-shell-wiring tests plus the tui-shell.test.ts foreground-operation-lifecycle assertion fail; item 3's extracted fn (src/tui/turn-guard-source.ts insertTurnGuardResult) - reverting breaks the module export and fails all turn-guard-source.test.ts with a SyntaxError. All three re-applied and re-verified green (bun test src/review/turn-guard* src/tui/turn-guard*: 68 pass/0 fail; full src/tui suite via scripts/opentui-tests-no-skips.ts: 1267 pass/0 fail/0 skipped).

AC8.note: Live check run twice this session: 'env -u OPENROUTER_API_KEY bun scripts/turn-guard-live-check.ts' against the saved OpenRouter key in ~/.local/share/keryx/auth.json (no OPENROUTER_API_KEY env var), 8 synthetic cases (the original 6 plus 2 added this session for PR #720 item 6). Run 1 (before wording tweak): 7/8 correct, 7 Jev calls, cost $0.000159 - the new 'grep found no match, reported honestly' case was WRONGLY flagged by live Jev (contradiction ~63%; the deterministic layer correctly did NOT flag it, this was Jev's own live judgement being ambiguous about a bare grep exit-1 fact line with no stated reason). Reworded that case's final message to state explicitly that grep's own exit 1 means 'no matches', not failure, and reran. Run 2 (final): 8/8 correct, 7 Jev calls, cost $0.000160 - done-1..3 (~0.86-0.97 done prob), not-done-1 (deterministic, unmentioned bun-test failure), not-done-2 (~9-10% done), not-done-3 (~60-61% contradiction), done-4 grep-no-match-honest (~0.93 done, ~0.42 contradiction, NOT flagged), done-5 flaky-test-acknowledged (~0.67 done, ~0.42 contradiction, NOT flagged) - all matched expectFlagged. Total across both runs: 14 Jev calls, well under the ~40 cap and the ~20-call guidance for the re-run alone. No key printed at any point, only usage/cost figures from Jev's own response. Journaled honestly per instructions: run 1's miss is recorded above rather than omitted.

AC9.note: Docs: docs/docs/cli-reference.md Turn guard section documents --guard, /guard on|off, ShellConfig.turnGuard.enabled, the notice/modal, and that the guard sends the user request/final reply/deterministic facts redacted to Jev on OpenRouter; HELP_GROUPS/commands-by-task reference /guard and --guard. Import zones respected per the same session's import-policy tests (src/lib/import-policy.live.test.ts, src/lib/import-zones*, 13 pass/0 fail, recorded in the prior AC9 note).
